    "Name": "Gibson 70s Flying V CW",
    "Description": "The rock icon of the 1970s is back. The Gibson 70s Flying V captures the raw energy, futuristic styling, and scorching tone of classic rock s golden era. Built with a solid mahogany body and a lightning-fast Slim Taper mahogany neck, this guitar delivers incredible sustain and effortless playability across all 22 frets of its rich rosewood fingerboard. Armed with two high-output Gibson humbuckers, it pumps out the signature aggressive crunch and crystalline clarity that defined a generation of heavy riffs.
